achievements.name: First Power Star
achievements.detail: Collect a Power Star in Bob-omb Battlefield and carry it back to Peach's castle.

achievements.name: Wing Cap
achievements.detail: With 10 Power Stars, look up into the castle lobby sunbeam and press the red cap switch to unlock the Wing Cap.

achievements.name: Big Boo's Haunt
achievements.detail: With 12 Power Stars, defeat the Big Boo in the castle courtyard and enter the cage it was holding.

achievements.name: Dark World Key
achievements.detail: Defeat Bowser in the Dark World and use his key to unlock the basement.

achievements.name: Metal Cap
achievements.detail: Press the green cap switch in Hazy Maze Cave to unlock the Metal Cap.

achievements.name: Hundred-Coin Star
achievements.detail: Gather 100 coins in one course and take the Power Star that shows up.

achievements.name: Timed Slide
achievements.detail: Finish the Princess's Secret Slide in under 21 seconds for its second Power Star.

achievements.name: Fire Sea Key
achievements.detail: Defeat Bowser in the Fire Sea and use his key to open the upper floors.

achievements.name: Fifty-Star Door
achievements.detail: Gather 50 Power Stars and open the door to Tick Tock Clock and Rainbow Ride.

achievements.name: Endless Stairs
achievements.detail: Collect 70 Power Stars so the endless stairs finally reach a top.

achievements.name: Rescue Peach
achievements.detail: Defeat Bowser in the Sky and rescue Princess Peach.

achievements.name: Castle Roof
achievements.detail: With all 120 Power Stars, launch from the lakeside cannon and talk to Yoshi on the roof.
